entities.name: Shenmeng
entities.description: The Plane of Mountains and Seas, inspired by the Classic of Mountains and Seas; home of Mu Yanling.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: Planeswalker and water mage orphaned by a deluge, taken in by Li Shan.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: Planeswalker, teenage amnesiac who journeyed to find a legendary elixir to save his village from a plague.

entities.name: Li Shan
entities.description: Nomad and foster father of Yanling, presumed dead.

entities.name: Ten Wizards Mountain
entities.description: Mountain covered by waterfalls where Mu Yanling met Jiang Yanggu.

entities.name: Cloud Dream Lake
entities.description: A clanhold Yanling and Li Shan were headed to.

entities.name: Arrow Bamboo Forest
entities.description: Deadly forest pacified by Jiang Yanggu's arrival.

entities.name: Mount Zhaoyao
entities.description: Forest of stones near the Western Seas.

events.summary: Mu Yanling's village is destroyed by a crushing wave; Li Shan saves her and takes her in.
events.quote: Her life was saved and she was taken in by Li Shan .

events.summary: Li Shan collapses and disappears while traveling with Yanling to Cloud Dream Lake.
events.quote: a clanhold which Yanling and Li Shan were headed to when he collapsed and disappeared

events.summary: Yanling searches for Li Shan in the Dark Sea of Penglai.
events.quote: Yanling searched for Li Shan there.

events.summary: Mu Yanling meets Jiang Yanggu on Ten Wizards Mountain.
events.quote: This is where Mu Yanling met Jiang Yanggu .

events.summary: Jiang Yanggu's arrival pacifies the Arrow Bamboo Forest.
events.quote: which was pacified by the arrival of Jiang Yanggu

relations.quote: nomad and foster father of Yanling, presumed dead
